document.title: Infrastructure Health Report - 2026-03-19
document.content:
# Infrastructure Health Report — 2026-03-19

## Executive Summary
- **Status:** Warning
- **OpenClaw Gateway:** Online (Ok)
- **PM2 Services:** 14/15 Online (Whisper STOPPED)
- **Docker Containers:** 21 Up (2 Unhealthy: `lidaros-frontend`, `omiximo-email-automation`)
- **Disk Usage:** 70% (205GB Free) - OK
- **Memory:** 42% Used (15.7GB Available) - OK
- **GPU:** RTX 4090 - 83% VRAM Used (VLLM), 0% Util - OK

## Service Details

### PM2 Status
- **Whisper (ID 25):** STOPPED. Restart count 518. Needs investigation.
- **iam-website (ID 55):** Recently restarted (60m uptime, 39 restarts).
- **zenithcred-website (ID 44):** Recently restarted (42m uptime).
- All other services (kira-app, oopuo-website, etc.) are stable.

### Docker Status
- **Unhealthy:** `lidaros-frontend-1` and `omiximo-email-automation` are reporting unhealthy status.
- **Scribe & NextJS:** Healthy.
- **Databases:** Neo4j, Postgres, Redis, MinIO are all healthy.
- **Ollama:** Running.

### Resource Usage
- **Storage:** `/dev/sda1` is at 70%. Monitoring for >85% threshold.
- **RAM:** 11.7GB/27.5GB used. Plenty of headroom.
- **GPU:** 20.5GB/24.5GB VRAM allocated to VLLM. Temperature stable at 42C.

### OpenClaw Gateway
- Running via systemd.
- RPC Probe: OK.
- Multiple channel group policy warnings detected (allowlist but empty allowFrom) — affects Telegram/WhatsApp group message intake.

## Actions Taken/Required
1. **Alerted:** High severity alert generated for Whisper and Unhealthy containers.
2. **Monitoring:** Increased monitoring on `iam-website` due to high restart count.
